messages:
alex: Quick follow-up from yesterday's postmortem on the 1.2.0 latency regression. Need to lock owners and dates for remediation + SLO updates. TL;DR: recurring tail-latency spike under bursty traffic, KV-cache thrash, current SLO hits 3x error budget in last 7 days.
priya: Thanks. Can we scope the immediate 2-week fixes vs long term? I want clear owners for dashboard + alerting changes before EOD.
alex: Short list: (1) hotfix cache eviction tuning (2) dashboard + alert thresholds (3) canary/traffic shaping policy to limit burst effects.
marcel: I'll take cache eviction tuning. Target: patch by next Tue (2024-06-11). PR will be small, testing on staging.
jamie: I'll own dashboard & alerting. Plan: update SLO dashboard panels, add a 95/99/99.9 breakdown, and change alert to fire on grouped 99.9 > 250ms for 5m. Will post diff link.
diane: From product: we need a temporary SLA note for accounts that hit degraded latency. Can we get a timeline for customer comms?
alex: Diane, propose we hold comms until we have the canary in prod and the error budget burn stops for 48h. If that happens by Fri, we draft a short note.
marcel: Cache change details in staging runbook snippet: ```yaml
cache:
  kv_max_items: 200000
  eviction_policy: lru_window
  lru_window_ms: 1200
```
marcel: Will run 6h soak on staging, then canary 2 nodes in prod at 20% traffic.
jamie: Dashboard plan: add a per-route 99.9 latency tile, and a daily time-series for error-budget consumption. Alert rule (draft): ```sql
WHEN p99_99(latency_ms) > 250 FOR 5m
AND traffic_volume > 50rps
THEN page eng-oncall
```
alex: Decision: SLO targets remain the same for now (latency 99.9 < 200ms), but we'll add a temporary soft-threshold alert at 250ms to catch regressions earlier. If error budget spends > 20% in 7d, auto-trigger a remediation runbook and ops-huddle.
priya: Timeline check: marcel (cache) -> Tue; jamie (dash/alerts) -> Wed EOD; alex to schedule remediation huddle Thu morning if burn continues.
jamie: PR for dashboard/alerts: https://go/redwood/pr/4827 (wip). Will add reviewers @priya @alex.
marcel: PR for cache tuning: https://go/redwood/pr/4829. Staging soak started 1745004800.
ops-bot: Incident follow-up created: https://go/redwood/incidents/INC-2024-214 — reminders set for 2024-06-13 10:00 UTC.
alex: Ownership confirmed. Next steps: (A) marcel deploy + canary, (B) jamie push alerts + validate noise, (C) priya coordinate rollbacks and capacity policy if canary shows improvement. We'll reconvene in the huddle Thu 10:00 UTC (calendar invite sent). Please add any outstanding tasks to the incident doc. :thumbsup:
priya: Adding a quick note — add synthetic check that simulates bursty traffic pattern to validate eviction change. I'll add to the tests.
jamie: Agreed. Also creating a dashboard widget for 'recurring spike pattern' so weekly trends pop up in our SLO review.
alex: Great. I'll update the postmortem with these owners/timelines now. If anyone needs to reassign, ping here.
